question: What dated display and native-resolution scene-classification context is available around the historical review locations?
scl_counts: Native cells with centres inside the WGS84 AOI; valid and masked counts separately, all class labels descriptive, no ground-truth accuracy
rgb: Provider TCI display only, native grid, no reflectance or quantitative colour interpretation; no scene-dependent stretch
unknown_class_policy: Report unexpected values, fail class interpretation rather than recode them
historical_overlay: 2018 audit-centre locators only, not current stations, waypoints, change or validation
calibrated_context_experiment_01_status: Unresolved provider sample representation; this experiment does not clear its reflectance gate
